title: Varda header
description: A fixed header drawn as cells of the hero's grid. Desktop: a 72px row inside the gutter frame, six equal cells (icon + wide wordmark, two empty see-through cells, two labelled link cells with line icons, and Menu with a hamburger) in off-white hairlines. Phones: the right third of the hero's top row, a tall logo cell over a menu cell. After half a screen of scroll it collapses in 0.5s to two solid squares (icon, hamburger) as the labels fade. Cells fill pale with navy text on hover; Menu opens a full-screen list.
notes: fixed and out of the flow: the page's first section runs under it (varda-hero leaves room for it)
needs JavaScript (hydrate: load) for the collapse and the menu; static HTML shows the full header
best on dark themes: the cells use the page colour with foreground hairlines
